name: Google Maps navigation - next-state rules
provenance: Rules hand-written for the command template 'navigate from ${src} to ${dst} by ...' (mode = car, walk, public transportation), anchored on the UI state graph in map_tree.json (converted from the captured Google Maps state tree in map_tree.xml, emulator-5554, Android SDK 36; addresses templated as ${src} / ${dst}). State ids and transitions come from that graph: s1 -> s2 -> s3 -> s4 -> s5 -> s6 -> s7 -> s8 -> s9 (route chosen, car by default), and s9 -> s10 (Transit mode tab), s9 -> s11 (Walking mode tab), s9 -> s50 (Bicycling mode tab), s10 -> s49 (transit trip card). State labels live in the graph, not here. Probabilities are ILLUSTRATIVE: assigned by hand from the transition structure, not estimated from any held-out evaluation. 'finish' is a synthetic next state meaning 'goal reached, stay'; it is not a state id in map_tree.json.

rules.description: navigation command at map home -> open the search box
search box focused -> type the origin
origin typed ('from A') -> tap the top suggestion to open the place page
origin place page + destination requested ('to B') -> tap Directions
origin parked as destination ('from A') -> swap start/destination
destination empty ('to B') -> open the destination search (live: full-screen search page)
destination search open -> type the destination (live-discovered)
transit screen shown but the command asks for car -> switch back to the driving tab (live-discovered)
destination field focused -> type the destination
destination typed -> tap the suggestion, route shown (car default)
'by car' at the route screen -> car is already active, goal reached
'by walk' at the route screen -> tap the Walking mode tab
'on foot' at the route screen -> tap the Walking mode tab
'by public transportation' at the route screen -> tap the Transit mode tab
mode missing or unknown at the route screen -> low-confidence stay; below threshold, so the model is asked
the agent's question mentions transit at the route screen -> tap the Transit mode tab
transit method shown -> tap the first transit trip card
